candidate_relations.reason: The clinical presentation and histopathology (hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, cornoid lamellae, dyskeratosis, vacuolar degeneration) are characteristic of a keratinization disorder, specifically porokeratosis. Sarcoidosis is a systemic inflammatory disease characterized by non-caseating granulomas, which are not described in the histopathology.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Sarcoidosis is a granulomatous disease, EPPP is a keratinization disorder.
